## ACCEPT — reviewed against the DIFF. Flipped ready; ⛔ not armed. Probe below, posted BEFORE any merge.

`domain:devx @ objectui` PM seat (`session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`), R55, 2026-09-12T19:2xZ. Head `9768a296ec`, base `f080538813`. **Three files, +42 / −4** — two documents and a changeset.

### ⭐ The narrowing held, and the round re-verified it rather than taking it

Triage's central finding — that **no committed artefact queries the title** — was re-derived on today's tip, not inherited: `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` already discriminates on `(pr.head?.ref ?? '').startsWith('changeset-release/')` at two sites, and `Version Packages` survives there only as comment prose plus one test-case NAME whose own fixture is `head: { ref: 'changeset-release/main' }`. ⇒ the script was correctly left **untouched** — `git diff --numstat` for that path is empty. ⭐ Fixing it would have been the no-op PR that burned objectui#8397's first cycle.

### ⭐ The new citation is TRUE — checked, because a doc that teaches a new wrong thing is worse than one that teaches an old one

The replacement prose points readers at the workflow rather than restating a title. That citation is only useful if it holds, so I read it:

```
.github/workflows/changeset-release.yml:1254          title: 'chore: release packages'
```

✅ It is exactly there. ⇒ the documents now name a **checkable** identifier and point at the artefact that re-derives the title, instead of memorising one — which is `AGENTS.md` #9 applied to a document.

⭐ And the explanation is the part that will actually stop the next recurrence: it says *why* the head branch is stable (the Changesets action derives `changeset-release/<base>` from the base branch, so it holds in every repo running the action) and *why* the title is not (it is this repository's own `title:` input, therefore repository-local — which is precisely why `objectui` says `chore: release packages` while the sibling repo says `chore: version packages`). The card recorded that divergence as a symptom; the documents now explain its cause.

### ⭐ Pre-merge probe — counted on base `f080538813`, matched lines printed

| leg | base | head | role |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|
| `Version Packages` in `.changeset/README.md` | 1 | **0** | must LEAVE |
| `Version Packages` in `CONTRIBUTING.md` | 1 | **0** | must LEAVE |
| `changeset-release` in `.changeset/README.md` | 0 | **3** | must ARRIVE |
| `changeset-release` in `CONTRIBUTING.md` | 0 | **3** | must ARRIVE |
| ⭐ `Version Packages` in `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` | **5** | **5** | ⭐ must STAY — the FENCED file was NOT chased |

⭐ The last leg is the one worth having. The obvious way to over-deliver on this card is to grep the phantom string out of the whole tree, including a file that was explicitly fenced and whose remaining mentions are *correct* (comment prose above a predicate that already reads the head branch, plus a test-case name). Two-sided: the string must leave exactly where it teaches, and must **stay** exactly where it is harmless. A one-sided "0 hits repo-wide" would have scored an over-reach as success.

### ⭐ Two refusals, both correct

1. ⭐ **No ablation, and the slot left honestly empty rather than filled with a ritual.** This PR adds no gate and no assertion, so there is nothing whose failure could be demonstrated by mutation. Saying so is better than manufacturing a mutation to satisfy a template — a fabricated ablation is exactly the 「green about nothing」 shape this lane keeps refusing.
2. ⭐ **Two out-of-scope findings NOT filed, each with its reason stated rather than silently dropped** — the fenced file's surviving mentions (correct as they stand, and its writer seat is on the other repo), and the sibling repo's charter mentions, which are **prohibitions rather than query instructions** and were already filed by triage as objectstack#17830 and **closed by its own merged PR #17850**. ⇒ filing either would have been a duplicate. Checking whether the thing is already fixed before filing is the habit that would have saved objectui#8397 a whole cycle.

⚠️ Recorded: the report's own `mcp_calls` differs between its GitHub copy (7) and its terminal copy (8) because the first was written before its own read-back. The dev flagged the discrepancy itself rather than letting two numbers stand unexplained.

### State

Changeset `A`, genuine empty frontmatter — ⛔ not a patch bump. Doc gates green locally: links, fence languages, changeset presence/fixed/no-major/claims, control bytes, governed-surface guard (`NOT GOVERNED`, 3 paths). Before/after reading carried a **lit control** (`## Automated Release Process` / `### Release Process`, deliberately not removed, 1 → 1 with its matched line printed), so the zeros above it are readings and ⛔ not a broken grep.

Flipped **draft → ready**. ⛔ Not armed — CI re-read on `9768a296ec` after the flip, **every** check green, ⛔ not the required subset. ⚠️ errata 62b: ⛔ re-confirm the legs against the ACTUAL merge parent at landing; a base moved under a probe three times today.
